seance: U07 – Vocabulaire B2 : collocations, phrasal verbs et formation des mots
resume: Enrichir son vocabulaire de façon efficace : les collocations (make / do, have / take…), les phrasal verbs essentiels du niveau B2, et la formation des mots avec préfixes et suffixes.

sections.contenu:
Une **collocation** est une association de mots naturelle (« prendre une décision » → *make a decision*, pas ~~take~~).

| ***make*** (créer, produire) | ***do*** (tâche, activité) |
| --- | --- |
| *a decision, a mistake, a mess, money, a phone call, an effort, progress, an appointment, a suggestion, a complaint, noise* | *homework, the dishes, the shopping, a job, business, research, an exercise, your best, a favour, damage* |

| ***take*** | ***have*** |
| --- | --- |
| *a photo, a break, an exam, a risk, notes, a decision (GB aussi), care of, part in, place (avoir lieu)* | *a shower, a meal, a good time, a look, an argument, a meeting, fun* |

Autres : *pay attention* (faire attention), *keep a promise, break a rule, catch a cold, save time, waste time, raise awareness*.

| Phrasal verb | Sens | Exemple |
| --- | --- | --- |
| *carry out* | réaliser, mener | *carry out a survey / tests* |
| *set up* | mettre en place, créer | *set up a company / a server* |
| *come up with* | trouver (idée) | *come up with a solution* |
| *put off* | reporter | *They put off the meeting.* |
| *call off* | annuler | *The match was called off.* |
| *run out of* | être à court de | *We've run out of paper.* |
| *figure out* | comprendre, trouver | *I can't figure out the problem.* |
| *turn down* | refuser (offre) / baisser (son) | *She turned down the job.* |
| *bring up* | aborder (sujet) / élever (enfant) | *Don't bring up politics.* |
| *deal with* | gérer, s'occuper de | *I'll deal with the client.* |
| *point out* | faire remarquer | *He pointed out an error.* |
| *look into* | examiner, étudier | *We're looking into the issue.* |
| *get along (with)* | bien s'entendre | *I get along with my colleagues.* |
| *break down* | tomber en panne | *My car broke down.* |

choix: The meeting will take place on Monday.

The meeting will make place on Monday.
The meeting will do place on Monday.
